question: What common current does scripture name as rising in the self?
premises: it runs from the grasping of states to their very end
it carries the common name spanda
scripture says it is self-rising in the self
inference: spanda is the common name for the self-rising current in the self
plain_english: Scripture gives it the common name spanda: the current running from the first grasp of a state to its end, rising in the self.
